text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambia press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Operations in all councils in the mining Copperbelt province have ground to a halt because of a strike by public workers now spreading to the capital.
- Eight Zairean soldiers fleeing turmoil in that country have been granted asylum in Zambia.
- Malawi President Bakili Muluzi has called for an increase in trade with Zambia.
- Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines will soon close its accounts with commercial banks in readiness for privatisation.
- Sweden will not resume its balance of payment support programme to Zambia until the country improves its good governance record.
